brief:
Palestinian factions have called for national unity and intensified resistance operations in the occupied West Bank, according to Shehab Wire. The groups issued their appeal in response to what they described as ongoing Israeli occupation and settler activities targeting Palestinian villages, towns, and property across the territory.

The statement underscores divisions among Palestinian political movements that have periodically sought to coordinate strategy. Resistance activities in the West Bank have remained a focal point of factional messaging, even as the groups maintain separate organizational structures and political agendas across Palestinian territories.
